diagnostic_name: TRAFFIC overlap / pure-host diagnostic (class_A=traffic_follow slice purity)
spec: experiments/mission_v3/T429_D1_diagnostics_spec.md (v2), section D1-B; two-step architecture: MATLAB mechanical export + Python statistics

replay.lineage_check: replay ACCEPT + stratum_id + base_draw_index match against manifest row: all 27 passed

slice_convention.rule: windows start at t_start+30, stride 60, fully inside [t_start+30, t_end-30]
slice_convention.follow_platform: [t + 0.1d, t + 0.9d] (T-010 FD4: first/last 10% of event duration = ramp)

pure_slice_supply_backsolve.design_feasibility: duration ~ U[60,180] -> L_follow = 0.8*d in [48,144] < 180: no event can ever host a buffered pure 120 s slice (design mismatch)

in_class_p_contrast.reason: branch B Step 1 export carries no P_load stream (spec allows: 'Step 1 P optional, branch B may omit'); interval statistics only

verdict_rule: of<1 frac > 0.5 AND n(L_follow>=180)==0 -> HOST_CONTAMINATION_CONFIRMED; of<1 frac <= 0.10 -> NOT_HOST_ISSUE; else CONTAMINATION_MINOR
notes: Per-slice detail (voyage/stratum/segment/s0/s1/of) is held in the export + recomputable from it; not duplicated here.

The 27-voyage replay yields 173 candidate A-class slices on the same convention; the T-022 corpus counted 458 (full 108-draw corpus), so counts are not directly comparable - the demand constant 458 is taken from T-022 as specified.
